title: 以真实 API 验证 WebApp 状态子资源、结构约束和展示列
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台自动启动并回收本题非root、回环监听的API Server v1.34.1/etcd3.6.4；无控制器或工作负载。初始CRD有spec schema但缺status能力，其他文件只读。

## 操作任务
只编辑crd.json。保留原CRD身份、Namespaced范围、v1alpha1版本与全部spec约束，添加独立status子资源，不能启用其他子资源、版本或conversion webhook。
status是object，只声明readyReplicas、observedGeneration两个非负integer字段，不开放任意未知字段，也不增加必填要求。新增默认显示的Ready整数列（.status.readyReplicas）和Age日期列（.metadata.creationTimestamp），description可自行写。
平台自动创建真实临时API Server与etcd，提交完整WebApp，使用带status外层的sample-status.json调用/status；普通主资源写入不能设置status，status写入不能改变spec。两个字段的负数/错误类型必须由服务器拒绝；保留spec.replicas的1到5范围。observedGeneration只根据实时metadata.generation设置，不能假定固定数值。
验证会分离状态写者和spec写者身份，用真实RBAC验证不能跨子资源写入，并测试过期resourceVersion与服务器Table列。你不需要另外打开Kubernetes。无Operator控制器、节点或Pod，本题只能证明API数据/权限契约，不能证明服务副本真的Ready。
提交文件必须小于32KiB，JSON对象键不得重复。
两个状态字段应使用type: integer与minimum: 0，可添加description或exclusiveMinimum: false；不得设置maximum、enum、CEL等额外收窄非负整数范围的约束。

## 产物
crd.json完整CRD。

## 验收方法
真实服务器逐项检验状态隔离、负数/类型拒绝、未知字段裁剪、spec约束、代际与过期版本冲突、独立身份授权、Table展示；结束回收临时进程和数据。

import copy,hashlib,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=Path.cwd()
for name,digest in {'sample-status.json': '443cba766cd02e89964ff4d6ff4f0ac80cd4f2992bb07271e044082c957ecadc', 'namespace.yaml': '2d7c72805dc3b1ba6ed34628c0470a1f693ce7e38942d1b2a3322ec7c4fdc57e', 'webapp.json': '998d238e809a21e24a20a6ffc072c01b67877b51ed4fdf4e80975b14a710dd69'}.items():assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'fixture changed'
def pairs(items):
    result={}
    for key,value in items:assert key not in result,'duplicate JSON key';result[key]=value
    return result
p=ROOT/'crd.json';assert p.stat().st_size<32768
crd=json.loads(p.read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs);baseline={'apiVersion': 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'CustomResourceDefinition', 'metadata': {'name': 'webapps.training.example.com'}, 'spec': {'group': 'training.example.com', 'scope': 'Namespaced', 'names': {'plural': 'webapps', 'singular': 'webapp', 'kind': 'WebApp'}, 'versions': [{'name': 'v1alpha1', 'served': True, 'storage': True, 'schema': {'openAPIV3Schema': {'type': 'object', 'required': ['spec'], 'properties': {'spec': {'type': 'object', 'required': ['image', 'replicas'], 'properties': {'image': {'type': 'string', 'minLength': 1}, 'replicas': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 1, 'maximum': 5}}}}}}}]}}
# Limit allowed changes to the exercise; no webhook, extra resource version,
# namespace/scope conversion, or weakened spec constraints can be installed.
check=copy.deepcopy(crd);v=check['spec']['versions'][0];v.pop('subresources',None);v.pop('additionalPrinterColumns',None)
v['schema']['openAPIV3Schema']['properties'].pop('status',None)
assert check==baseline,'only status schema/subresource/printer columns may change'
status_schema=crd['spec']['versions'][0]['schema']['openAPIV3Schema']['properties'].get('status',{})
assert isinstance(status_schema,dict) and status_schema.get('type')=='object'
assert set(status_schema)<={'type','properties','description'} and set(status_schema.get('properties',{}))=={'readyReplicas','observedGeneration'}
for field in status_schema['properties'].values():
    assert isinstance(field,dict) and set(field)<={'type','minimum','description','exclusiveMinimum'},'no hidden enum/maximum/CEL restriction on the nonnegative integer domain'
    assert field.get('type')=='integer' and field.get('minimum')==0 and field.get('exclusiveMinimum',False) is False
assert crd['spec']['versions'][0].get('subresources')=={'status':{}},'independent status subresource is required'
columns=crd['spec']['versions'][0].get('additionalPrinterColumns');assert isinstance(columns,list) and len(columns)==2
assert {c.get('name') for c in columns}=={'Ready','Age'}
assert all(set(c)<={'name','type','jsonPath','description','priority'} and c.get('priority',0)==0 for c in columns)
CRD='/apis/apiextensions.k8s.io/v1/customresourcedefinitions';COL='/apis/training.example.com/v1alpha1/namespaces/training/webapps';ITEM=COL+'/demo'
with ControlPlane() as api:
    api.create(CRD,crd);api.wait_crd(crd['metadata']['name'])
    fixture=json.loads((ROOT/'webapp.json').read_text());initial=copy.deepcopy(fixture);initial['status']={'readyReplicas':99}
    created=api.create(COL,initial);uid=created['metadata']['uid'];assert not created.get('status'),'ordinary create must not set status'
    status_patch=json.loads((ROOT/'sample-status.json').read_text())
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',status_patch,content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200,(code,obj)
    assert obj['status']['readyReplicas']==2 and obj['spec']==fixture['spec']
    # All integers and boundary failures are admitted/rejected by real CRD validation.
    for key in ('readyReplicas','observedGeneration'):
        for good in (0,1,7,8,23,4096,2147483648):
            code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{key:good}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200,(key,good,code,obj)
        for bad in (-1,'2',True,1.25):
            before=api.get(ITEM);code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{key:bad}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==422,(key,bad,code,obj)
            assert api.get(ITEM)['status']==before['status']
    # Unknown status fields are pruned; user data must not become an arbitrary
    # unvalidated blob via preserve-unknown-fields or an unconstrained schema.
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'readyReplicas':2,'untrustedExtra':'not-persisted'}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200
    assert 'untrustedExtra' not in obj['status']
    for replicas in (0,6,'2'):
        code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'replicas':replicas}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==422,(replicas,code,obj)
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'replicas':3},'status':{'readyReplicas':99}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200 and obj['spec']['replicas']==3 and obj['status']['readyReplicas']==2
    generation=obj['metadata']['generation'];assert generation>created['metadata']['generation']
    spec=copy.deepcopy(obj['spec']);rv=obj['metadata']['resourceVersion']
    code,obj=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'readyReplicas':3,'observedGeneration':generation},'spec':{'image':'cannot-change-via-status'}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json')
    assert code==200 and obj['spec']==spec and obj['status']=={'readyReplicas':3,'observedGeneration':generation} and obj['metadata']['generation']==generation
    stale=copy.deepcopy(obj);stale['metadata']['resourceVersion']=rv;stale['status']['readyReplicas']=4
    code,result=api.request('PUT',ITEM+'/status',stale);assert code==409,(code,result)
    assert api.get(ITEM)['status']['readyReplicas']==3
    # Actual RBAC subresource authorization differs from the main resource.
    api.identity('status-writer');api.identity('spec-writer')
    RB='/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/training/'
    for name,resource in (('status-writer','webapps/status'),('spec-writer','webapps')):
        role={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name,'namespace':'training'},'rules':[{'apiGroups':['training.example.com'],'resources':[resource],'verbs':['patch']}]}
        binding={'apiVersion':role['apiVersion'],'kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':role['metadata'],'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','name':name,'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io'}]}
        api.create(RB+'roles',role);api.create(RB+'rolebindings',binding)
    until=time.monotonic()+5
    while time.monotonic()<until:
        code,result=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'readyReplicas':2}},user='status-writer',content_type='application/merge-patch+json')
        if code==200:break
        time.sleep(.1)
    assert code==200,(code,result)
    assert api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'replicas':4}},user='status-writer',content_type='application/merge-patch+json')[0]==403
    assert api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'readyReplicas':5}},user='spec-writer',content_type='application/merge-patch+json')[0]==403
    code,result=api.request('PATCH',ITEM,{'spec':{'replicas':4}},user='spec-writer',content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200,(code,result)
    # Distinguish ready count from observedGeneration and desired replicas.
    # A single value of 2 previously let the wrong status field masquerade as Ready.
    current=api.get(ITEM);observed=current['metadata']['generation']
    assert observed not in (0,1,2) and current['spec']['replicas']==4
    for ready in (0,1,2):
        code,state=api.request('PATCH',ITEM+'/status',{'status':{'readyReplicas':ready,'observedGeneration':observed}},content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert code==200
        assert state['metadata']['generation']==observed and state['spec']['replicas']==4
        code,table=api.request('GET',COL,headers={'Accept':'application/json;as=Table;g=meta.k8s.io;v=v1'});assert code==200 and table.get('kind')=='Table',(code,table)
        columns=table['columnDefinitions'];indexes={c['name']:i for i,c in enumerate(columns)}
        assert {'Name','Ready','Age'}<=set(indexes)
        assert columns[indexes['Ready']]['type']=='integer' and columns[indexes['Age']]['type']=='date'
        rows=table['rows'];assert len(rows)==1 and rows[0]['cells'][indexes['Ready']]==ready,(ready,rows)
        assert rows[0]['cells'][indexes['Age']] not in ('',None,'<unknown>')
    final=api.get(ITEM);assert final['metadata']['uid']==uid and final['spec']['replicas']==4 and final['status']['readyReplicas']==2
print('Real CRD validation/pruning, status write isolation, main/subresource RBAC, generation/resourceVersion and server Table rendering passed; no Operator reconcile loop exists')

assessment.validation_scope: Native isolated CRD API behavior, no controllers or workloads.
